issues.title: Missing GWT blocks for core authoring rules
issues.why: While the spec mandates GWT (Given/When/Then) blocks for all modules, the guide itself only provides one example (AC-SAG-000) and lacks coverage for naming, numbering, and folder placement rules.
issues.fix: Add a comprehensive 97-acceptance-criteria.md with GWT blocks for every invariant listed in the Phase 48/52 contracts.

issues.title: Undefined conflict resolution for numbering gaps
issues.why: The spec acknowledges historical gaps in numbering but does not define how an AI should handle a collision if two agents attempt to use the 'next available number' simultaneously.
issues.fix: Add a concurrency section requiring a 'lock' file or a specific git-rebase strategy for numeric prefix allocation.

issues.title: Unresolved external script references
issues.why: The spec references several scripts (e.g., audit-spec-v2.py, generate-gwt-acceptance.py) as mandatory infrastructure but does not provide their interface or location within the provided context.
issues.fix: Include a 'Linter Interface' section defining the CLI arguments and expected JSON output for referenced scripts.
